question: Can the existing Wingless raw-byte substrate learn useful predictive structure from real UTF-8 prose/code bytes with a fixed bounded learned state and no tokenizer, improving held-out next-byte prediction where learned motifs apply while reducing effective event count?
hypothesis: On an immutable repo-owned train/eval split, a fixed 256-entry four-byte motif layer over a fixed 256x256 one-byte-context baseline will cover at least 5% of held-out evaluation positions, improve top-1 next-byte accuracy by at least 0.10 on motif-covered positions, reduce held-out event count by at least 0.03, and not worsen overall held-out bits-per-byte by more than 0.02 versus the baseline.
authority: research-only real-byte pilot; no deployment or external-model inference authority

corpus.encoding: raw file bytes exactly as stored; UTF-8 text/code; no tokenization, normalization, decoding, remapping, or inserted boundary tokens
corpus.file_boundary_policy: reset byte context/window state at each file boundary; file identity is evaluator/training orchestration only and is not supplied as a model feature
corpus.contamination_rule: No evaluation file bytes may be added to training and no corpus file may be modified under this experiment identifier.

learner.baseline: fixed 256x256 uint32 counts indexed by previous raw byte and candidate next byte; prediction argmax with lowest-byte tie break
learner.motif_candidates: all observed four-byte windows with following byte in training files
learner.motif_score: best-successor count descending, then best-successor fraction descending, then lexicographic four-byte key
learner.motif_state: selected four-byte key plus 256 successor counts per selected motif; no capacity growth
learner.adaptive_prediction: if the last four raw bytes exactly match a selected motif, use that motif successor distribution/prediction; otherwise use one-byte-context baseline
learner.probability: Jeffreys-smoothed categorical probability (count+0.5)/(context_total+128) for bits-per-byte; adaptive uses selected motif distribution when matched, otherwise baseline

evaluation.metrics_scope: all next-byte positions after at least one prior byte; motif-covered metrics require four prior bytes and selected exact motif match
evaluation.baseline_bpb: mean -log2 baseline probability on heldout bytes
evaluation.adaptive_bpb: mean -log2 adaptive probability on heldout bytes
evaluation.motif_covered_accuracy_gain: adaptive top-1 accuracy minus baseline top-1 accuracy restricted to motif-covered positions
evaluation.event_reduction: greedy scan per evaluation file; selected four-byte motif span counts as one event instead of four raw byte events

classification_rules.supported: All frozen thresholds and validity criteria pass.
classification_rules.mixed: Real-byte motif learning improves covered-position prediction or event efficiency but at least one coverage/BPB threshold fails.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but motif layer yields no predictive or event-reduction advantage over the raw-byte baseline.
classification_rules.incomplete: Corpus or compute interruption prevents complete frozen evaluation.
classification_rules.invalid: Corpus identity, train/eval isolation, raw-byte identity, capacity, deterministic construction, or qualification isolation fails.

no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not change corpus files/blobs, motif capacity/filter/score, smoothing, metrics, thresholds, split, or classification after observing output.
